## Description

Scans change-of-control clauses across customer AND supplier contracts, debt covenants, and executive compensation, and assesses post-acquisition attrition risk including a retained seller who continues as an ongoing supplier post-close — the same risk category as a customer contract, not a separate one (pilot 002 finding F-2). Mandatory Brown Field DD validator (`checklists/ma-special-topics-checklist.yaml` ma-07/ma-08). Use when: "customer attrition risk", "change of control clause", "customer concentration risk", "retained seller as supplier".
